scenes.say: Four wheels over the white line, and the lap is gone. How do track limits work?
The white line counts as part of the track, the kerb doesn't. With all four wheels over the line, the driver has left the track.
In qualifying that lap is simply deleted. Get the final corner wrong and the next lap can go as well.
In the race, the third offence brings the black and white flag, the fourth a five second penalty, the fifth ten seconds.
At the twenty twenty-three Austrian Grand Prix, officials had to check more than twelve hundred possible offences. The final result came five hours after the flag.

title: Track limits: how they're policed and what they cost
